note: Instructions only: nothing here is a result. Results are recorded by the named owner on real hardware.

shape.exportedAt: <required: when the console made this export, as an ISO date-time>
shape.sha: <required: the full 40-hex commit of the build on the device>
shape.tester: <required: the full name of the person who ran the cases>
shape.buildKind: <required: testflight: the store build (Parts A and B); development only for an earlier, optional Xcode run, which never replaces store-build rows>
shape.server: <required: staging (Part A, before GO) or production (Part B, after promotion)>

records.case: <required: a device-matrix item id from the checklist>
records.device: <the device model as Settings shows it; a pass or fail needs it>
records.os: <the OS name and version as the device shows it; a pass or fail needs it>
records.pencil: <the Apple Pencil model; a pass of the iPad WRITE case needs it>
records.severity: <P0, P1, P2 or P3; a fail needs it, nothing else carries one>
records.notes: <what the tester saw; a fail or blocked needs at least five characters>

soaks.device: <required: the device model as Settings shows it>
soaks.os: <the OS name and version as the device shows it>
soaks.pencil: <the Apple Pencil model, on an iPad>
soaks.minutes: <required: minutes of continuous use (a whole number)>
soaks.failures: <required: crashes, hangs, lost work and wrong marks seen, 0 when none (a whole number)>

evidenceExport.rules: One export per sitting and build, stamped with exportedAt when it is made, and imported soon after. Every value is what a person entered on the device: text (minutes and failures: whole numbers), never a <placeholder> from this shape. The importer needs the recorder of #737 and writes only through scripts/device-matrix-record.mjs, after its own rules. One bad record refuses the WHOLE file and nothing is written: a tester that names an agent, CI, a bot or a placeholder, a simulator or emulator device (whatever the result), a build kind or server the recorder does not know, an unknown case, a short SHA, a duplicate case or soak, a value that is not text, a placeholder, or an export older than a result the ledger already holds for one of its cases (an older export, or the same one twice, never replaces a newer result: export again). Record a case through the console or the recorder, not both. release-record items are not imported: they go where their recordIn says.

items.title: Install and first launch
items.precondition: The TestFlight build of the candidate SHA is installed on this device. Part A runs it against staging (app.prilearning.com fronts staging until GO); Part B runs the same build against production after the promotion.
steps: Open the app.
Open its diagnostics and read the release SHA.
items.expected: The build installs from its test track and opens to the sign-in card. The release identity shown in the app's diagnostics equals the build SHA being recorded.
evidence: The release SHA the diagnostics show (it must equal the candidate).

items.title: Email one-time-code sign-in
items.precondition: The test mailbox is open on this device.
steps: Sign in to the adult test account with the email code.
Close the app fully, then reopen it.
items.expected: A 6-digit code reaches a real mailbox on this device; entering it signs in; the session survives closing and reopening the app.
evidence: Whether you were still signed in after reopening.

items.title: Guardian consent for a child account
items.precondition: Signed out. The other device is to hand as "the parent's own device", with the parent mailbox.
steps: Create a child test account on this device.
On the OTHER device, open /guardian/consent in Safari and approve with the parent's code.
Watch this device.
items.expected: A child account is held at "waiting for your parent" until the parent approves on /guardian/consent on THEIR OWN device with THEIR code; the child screen moves on by itself. Sync and server questions are refused until then.
evidence: Whether questions and sync were refused before approval.
Whether the child screen moved on by itself after approval.

items.title: Server-issued question
items.precondition: Signed in to the adult test account on this device.
steps: Open Practice and get a question.
Turn on aeroplane mode, then turn it off.
items.expected: A question is issued by the server and shown; aeroplane mode shows the offline state and the question is back when the network returns.
evidence: Whether the offline state showed and the question came back.

items.title: Handwriting input
items.precondition: Signed in to the adult test account on this device.
steps: Write the answer: a finger on iPhone; the Apple Pencil on iPad, with your palm resting on the screen.
Press "Read my answer".
items.expected: Writing with this family's input (finger / Apple Pencil / stylus) draws without lag or dropped strokes; on tablets the palm does not draw; "Read my answer" sends the picture.
evidence: Lag or dropped strokes, if any.
Whether the palm drew (iPad).
Whether the one-time prompt naming OpenAI (D17) appeared before anything was sent.
iPad: the Apple Pencil model.

items.title: Photo of working
items.precondition: Signed in to the adult test account on this device.
steps: Photograph a page of working.
Photograph it again holding the device sideways.
items.expected: The camera or picker captures a page of working; the picture is sent for reading; a photo taken sideways is shown the right way up.
evidence: Whether the photo was sent for reading.
Whether the sideways photo shows the right way up.

items.title: Transcript shown; explicit correction or confirmation
items.precondition: A handwritten or photographed answer has been read.
steps: Correct one misread line.
Confirm the transcript.
items.expected: The transcript is shown line by line; a misread line can be corrected; when the reader is unsure the student must confirm before marking.
evidence: Whether an unsure reading asked you to confirm before marking.

items.title: Server mark and criterion feedback
items.precondition: Signed in to the adult test account on this device.
steps: Submit a wrong answer.
Submit the right answer.
items.expected: The mark comes from the server with marks earned / possible and the first-error feedback; a wrong answer gets its second try; a correct answer shows the worked solution.
evidence: The mark shown (earned / possible) and its first-error feedback.
Whether the worked solution appeared after the right answer.

items.title: History and persistent sync
items.precondition: Both devices signed in to the same adult test account.
steps: Close and reopen the app.
Open History on this device and on the other one.
items.expected: The attempt is in History, is still there after the app is closed and reopened, and appears on a second signed-in device after sync.
evidence: Whether every attempt is in History on both devices.

items.title: Soak: continuous use through the second sitting
items.precondition: The second sitting (the TIMED, BACKGROUND, STORAGE, MEMORY, EXPORT and SHARE cases) run on the iPad in one go, on the TestFlight build. Part B runs one more soak against production.
steps: Note the time the second sitting starts and the time it ends.
Note every crash, hang, lost piece of work or wrong mark in between.
items.expected: No crash or lost work in 45 minutes or more.
evidence: The minutes of continuous use.
The number of failures, with a note on each.
items.recordIn: the export's soaks list (with #737's recorder), with the same SHA, tester, build kind and server as its records

items.title: In-app account deletion
items.precondition: The last step: every other case on this device is done.
steps: Settings → Account → Delete, for each test account on this device.
Confirm with the password or the code.
Try to sign in with the same address.
items.expected: You are signed out; the account is gone, and signing in again starts a new account.
evidence: Whether each account is gone.
items.recordIn: GO/NO-GO record gates.store.evidence ("in-app deletion, iPhone and iPad, <SHA>, by <name>"); App Review guideline 5.1.1(v)

items.title: Sandbox purchase and restore
items.precondition: The Paid Apps Agreement is active and both products are priced (docs/release/OWNER-CLICK-LIST-APPLE-RAILWAY.md A1–A6). Until then this item is BLOCKED.
steps: Settings → App Store → Sandbox Account: sign in to a sandbox Apple Account.
Buy the monthly plan on the Premium screen.
Delete and reinstall the app, then "Restore purchases".
items.expected: Premium after the purchase and after the restore, confirmed by the server (/v1/entitlements).
evidence: The /v1/entitlements answer after each step.

items.title: StoreKit sandbox certification
items.precondition: Billing is configured (docs/release/OWNER-CLICK-LIST-APPLE-RAILWAY.md A1–A6) and the sandbox purchase passed, on the TestFlight build against a server that allows Sandbox. Until then this item is BLOCKED.
steps: With the Sandbox Apple Account on the iPad: let a renewal happen (the sandbox clock is fast), turn auto-renew off and let it expire, run a billing-retry and grace test, request a refund through the sandbox, upgrade and downgrade, and switch accounts on the same iPad.
After each one, note what the app shows and run the billing reconcile.
items.expected: After each scenario the server's entitlement (/v1/entitlements) matches the store's state, and the reconcile run is clean.
evidence: For each scenario: what the device showed, the /v1/entitlements answer and the reconcile result.
items.recordIn: the release record, ios/PriLearning.swiftpm/RELEASE.md §11 (docs/billing/storekit-certification.md, external blocker 4)
